tasks.subject: Task 4 (v1.1): Never-miss-twice alarm
tasks.description:
DONE: commit 5907a5a (stack_complete/missed_twice, _maybe_miss_alarm, 9 new tests) + 5c14eab (review fix: try/except around load_plan(d1)/load_plan(d2) for the corrupt-file case, matching _run's existing pattern).
